description: Show the canonical AGRO install command on each landing page agent card, including grok, muse, and antigravity.

userStories.title: Show the canonical install command on each agent card
userStories.description: As a site visitor, I want each agent card to show its install command so that I type the canonical harness id.
acceptanceCriteria: Each entry in `AGENTS` in `src/pages/index.tsx` holds an `install` field with the canonical AGRO harness id, or no `install` field for an on-demand harness.
The `install` values are `claude`, `codex`, `opencode`, `pi`, `hermes`, `openclaw`, `grok`, `muse`, `antigravity`, and `fx`. The T3 Code entry has no `install` field.
Each card with an `install` field shows `agro harness install <install>` in a `<code>` element. The T3 Code card shows no install command.
The `id` of each entry stays unchanged, because each `id` is the slug of a synced doc page.

Verify in browser using agent-browser skill: the landing page shows `agro harness install grok`, `agro harness install muse`, `agro harness install antigravity`, and `agro harness install claude` on the agent cards, and shows no old id.

userStories.title: Record the manual review evidence
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want an annotated screenshot of the agent cards so that the PR `## Manual review` section shows the change.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/landing-install-ids/evidence/manual-review.md` embeds an annotated screenshot of the agent cards from `pnpm serve`. The callouts mark the Grok Build, Muse Code, and Antigravity CLI install commands.
The advisor stops `pnpm serve` after the capture.
After the merge, the live page at `https://agro.mifune.dev/` shows `agro harness install grok`, `agro harness install muse`, and `agro harness install antigravity`.
